honesty: CX_Mount_Horse may exist as a mesh reference. A ride controller does not. skill_craft_wagon and skill_craft_tack must not fake a mounted camera.
No seated driver clip. Lead, hitch, and enter-as-cargo are the honest verbs until an animator binds a sit.
The Held Curse is not a mount. Griffins are not horses. Sealie is not a bird and not a ride.
Quaternius is not a mount mesh donor.
